chapter: Morrison's, the Slipper and leaving music
title: Joining Buzzy Williams at the Slipper, October 1928
summary: A union magazine puts him at Morrison's in May 1928 and with Buzzy Williams at the Slipper that October; Lizana calls it a nice little place.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Yeah, I saw in a magazine... You remember when the union used to put a little magazine out? The Musicians' Union? Called the Prelude. I doubt if you remember that. But they had it in May of 1928. You were playing in Morrison's. I found that. And then it says you went with Buzzy Williams to the Slipper in October of 28. Yeah. You remember Buzzy? Oh, yeah. He's a night watchman now. Pan American Life Insurance. Last time I saw him, he was out there. I'd like to know, Buzzy. I haven't seen Buzzy Cock in a year. Well, I haven't seen him for a while, but the last I heard of him, he was out there.

Yeah. Just like the other night there, I said, yeah, no, I'm alive about three weeks ago. Mm-hmm. I get a letter in the mail, and I open it. And it's been so long since I've seen the boy, I didn't remember his name. Jake can't tell me who he was. Mm-hmm. And somebody sends me a letter, and greetings, you know, that I let nobody else in my piano play. I used to play with Mr. Griffo. What was his name? Emmett. No. Martin. Joe Martin. Huh? Joe Martin.
Huh? This is a recent group.
Anyway, you remember that band at the Slipper? You remember playing with Buzzy there, huh?
Oh, gosh, yeah. I don't know what he was wearing for years and years. Years. Not one day.
What was the Slipper like then, in those days?
It was a nice little place. It was nothing. A library, but very nice.
I know Abby was in there for a while, Abby Burney's.

Well, yes. Well, that's what I was trying to tell you. Well, go ahead. It's hard to say who's who and why to be accurate with it because of the fact that you get so many jump ins and outs and ins and outs.
